  Exam Date & Time: 14-Jun-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester Makeup Examination, June -2025  
  ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE [IT-4401]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           A warehouse robot uses a goal-based agent model. Examine how the environment type  
  (stochastic vs. deterministic) influences its behavior.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Create a custom heuristic function for a map navigation problem using informed search.  
  Justify your design.                                                                   (5)  
  
  2)           Assume given a two-player strategy game, construct the AND-OR tree and explain how  
  it optimizes decision making.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Analyze a case where proof by contradiction is more efficient than direct proof in a  
  propositional logic system.                                                                  (5)  
  
  3)           An e-commerce system uses First Order Logic to infer customer intent. Design how  
  rules can support personalization.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Compare the challenges of reasoning with default knowledge in autonomous driving  
  systems vs. categorization using ontologies.                                                 (5)  
  
  4)           In a smart home system, how can Bayes' Rule be applied to determine if someone is  
  home based on sensor data?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Given a Bayesian Network with the following structure  
  Cloudy → Sprinkler  
  Cloudy → Rain  
  Sprinkler → WetGrass  
  Rain → WetGrass                                                                              (5)  
  Write the joint probability distribution P(Cloudy, Sprinkler, Rain, WetGrass) as a  
  product of conditional probabilities based on the structure of the network.  
  Express P(WetGrass | Sprinkler, Rain) in terms of conditional probability table.  
  
  5)           Evaluate a scenario where a multi-attribute utility function is applied in a self-driving    (5)
